lines.text: 🚨 Drum-Belly, The Living Wire, Murkcap is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📓 Codex: Drum-Belly, The Living Wire, Murkcap at the door, day 16.
🛡️ Donna, Jerónimo and Antonella met them at the door — 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Donna, Jerónimo are hurt.
One of them is coming for YOU — Drum-Belly, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
Something out there knows exactly where you sleep. It isn't howling. That's the worst part — it isn't making a sound at all.
Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)
Investigate and the morning is gone — tracking them costs a full day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing. Your call.
The System's gifts are hungry: -60 kcal metabolic cost. Feed the power or lose it.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Onni traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
🍽️ Nadia looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."
📓 Codex: Nadia taught Antonella Silver Tongue.
🌿 Field Mustard — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Field Mustard: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🌿 Greenbrier Shoots — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Greenbrier Shoots: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hilda Diallo is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Hilda Diallo is dead — starvation. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Malik blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
📖 LEARNED: Sewing & Textiles (Level 1). Mend tears so they hold: backstitch, small stitches, match the grain.
📖 LEARNED: Repair & Mending (Level 1). Look at what's broken before you touch it: find the failure point, not the symptom. Most breaks are one small thing.
📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Hilda Diallo, 16 days. The mantle passes to Malik Moore.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Malik Moore, 67 — a tailor. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
The village's quarrel was with Hilda — and Hilda is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
The fire knew Malik before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
While you were gone — 3 things you missed:
⚔️ Donna stood down the Drum-Belly and kept walking — 3 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
🩸 The Living Wire mauled Jerónimo (-21 health) over 1 round. They're lucky to be breathing.
⚔️ Antonella stared down the Murkcap and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
You walk back into Haven. 18 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
◈ HAVEN — You've noticed: people cover for each other without being asked. The gaps close themselves.
The light is going. The day is spent — every small thing you did added up.
🗣️ Donna to David, by the fire: "Stone. We need 49 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
⚠ DEHYDRATED: find and treat water today.
Village meal: +2000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
The fire is quiet today. Nobody's talking much.
★ IDENTIFIED: Blackberry. Thorny canes, dark berries. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
Jerónimo was watching. Now they know Blackberry too.
Donna brought you a sample. The Codex grows.
Donna traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Antonella and Donna lingered over the fire together.
Nadia and Donna lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ David eyes the groaning pantry shelves and packs light today. "No point hauling what'll rot. Mending the nets instead."
🌿 Purslane — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Purslane: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
💧 The cistern won't cover today — the hall's call, no vote needed: half rations until the water runs come back.
🤒 Aroha is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
— DAY 17 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Blackberry — named and noted.
Dawn. You wake wrung out and unrepaired. (+85 health, wrung-out morning. You ran on empty — no water, no food, no real recovery. The body keeps score. (Drink and eat before you sleep.))
Nothing to eat. The pantry of your pack is empty.
Took Canned soup.
You eat Canned soup (250 kcal).
Took Canned soup.
You eat Canned soup (250 kcal).
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
"You haven't earned that yet," Divya says. (Trust too low.)
The water stills. A faint crackling rises — the hairs on your arms lift. This is the warning.
⚡ It moves.
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE LIVING WIRE! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
It comes apart — no one in reach, no one chasing. The fight ends; they melt back into the wilds.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (You lived to tell it — twice — and now you see the pattern.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Get OUT of the water — When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
🌱 Donna works the garden — watered, weeded, turned. Nothing ripe yet.
🎣 Divya worked the creek — 2 fish, +280 kcal to the pantry.
David showed Nadia the Sugar Maple — "remember it." Word gets around.
🩹 Jerónimo is still hurting (26 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
👥 Antonella heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
👥 Nadia walks out with Antonella. "Nobody walks alone today."
👥 Onni heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
💧 Naran returns with water: +2 clean.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Divya looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
🎣 Divya worked the creek — 1 fish, +105 kcal to the pantry.
You catch fragments by the fire — Donna telling Aroha about Onni. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — Nadia telling Donna about Someone. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — Donna telling Onni about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
💧 Dale returns with water: +2 clean.
👥 Naran heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
🛟 Divya stands up by the fire. "Nobody's saying it, so I will: we need a plan, tonight. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"There's hurt to tend and bellies to fill. Triage for the hurt, rations to stretch what's left, or a hard hunt to replace what we lost."
"Or we rally," Divya adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
📓 Codex: Divya proposed relief (raid), day 17.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
"You haven't earned that yet," Divya says. (Trust too low.)
🎣 Divya worked the creek — 2 fish, +280 kcal to the pantry.
You catch fragments by the fire — Aroha telling Naran about Onni. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — everyone's talking about it now.
